sections.title: Situation Report
sections.heading: Hold P5, create two climb lanes
lines: User target remains position 2 or better before finals.
P5 means matching every favourite may hold ground but probably will not gain enough.
Round 23 should therefore carry two controlled differentiators while keeping the high-confidence favourites.
The recommended card is Cowboys, Warriors, Roosters, Sea Eagles, Dolphins, Rabbitohs, Raiders and Sharks.
Do not add more underdogs unless a fresh ladder screenshot proves the gap to 2nd demands it.

sections.heading: Do not ignore team news
lines: Roosters are monitoring James Tedesco's ankle, though Lindsay Collins and Billy Smith are listed to return.
Penrith remain without Dylan Edwards and are managing availability concerns, which supports the Warriors split.
Melbourne regain Cameron Munster, but Jahrome Hughes and Harry Grant remain out; that keeps Sea Eagles viable.

Sharks remain short KL Iro and Siosifa Talakai, but the market and model still make Cronulla the protect pick.
